label: lane S synthetic (SmartSpaces) — zero-shot, not a product claim; NVIDIA terms unresolved
caveats: lane S synthetic (SmartSpaces) — zero-shot, not a product claim; NVIDIA terms unresolved
Zero-shot COCO weights; SmartSpaces is rendered (no sensor noise model).
720p/360p are downscales of the decoded 1080p frame with no re-compression: optimistic against a low-bitrate camera.
Height buckets use the height at the evaluated resolution; a bucket with fewer than 30 GT instances is marked too_thin.
Frames inside a re-render's post-cut transient (A2, 60 frames) are excluded from every metric.
Only RT-DETRv2-S was evaluated; YOLOX-S is signed but has no backend yet, so no candidate selection took place.
No timing, throughput, CPU or latency figure is measured or reported.
